questions.question: Explain tuning Ansible concurrency safely.
questions.sampleAnswer: Ansible concurrency determines how many hosts and tasks can progress simultaneously. forks, serial, throttle and strategy settings control different dimensions. questions.sampleAnswer: Automation can expose sensitive values in task arguments, diffs, registered results or debug output. no_log suppresses selected task output but does not secure every downstream use or generated file.
